# nb-studio comment

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## comment delete

Delete a comment

By its author, or by whoever may moderate comments on the issue. Its files go with it.

```bash
nb-studio comment delete <comment>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `comment` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this comment and its files?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/comments/{commentId}` (`projectsDeleteComment`)

## comment react

React to a comment

Answers the comment’s reactions after the change.

```bash
nb-studio comment react <comment> <emoji>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `comment` |             |
| `emoji`   |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/comments/{commentId}/react` (`projectsReactComment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio comment react <comment> 👍
```

## comment resolve

## comment update

Edit a comment

By its author.

```bash
nb-studio comment update <comment> --content <string>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `comment` |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                          |
| ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `--content` | string | (required; or --content-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/comments/{commentId}` (`projectsUpdateComment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio comment update <comment> --content-file note.md
```
